arStrings.szText: "I'm looking to fight for coin. I hear you're the man to talk to."
Well, aren't you a cheery sight for a weary soul! A fighter is indeed what I'm seeking, and there's quite a bit of coin at stake.
You do look like you can handle yourself...but looks can deceive. I need a champion, and nothing less will do. Let's put it to the test, if you'll indulge me.

One of my more eccentric customers has been pestering me to procure the heart of a Bramble Golem for him. If you really are the sort of brawler you claim to be, why, that's hardly a challenge at all, is it?
